messages:
Etta Morales: hey everyone! super excited to join Redwood as a Product Designer — hi from the SF office. i'm a board game nerd, tea enthusiast, and i bake terrible-but-honest cookies. i'll bring a mix of chocolate chip + almond biscotti on my first day (tues). any allergies or preference? :cookie: :tea:
Priya Sengupta: welcome Etta!! :tada: peanut allergy in our team, so please avoid peanuts if possible. also yes to board games — Catan night Thursdays if you wanna join.
Luca Rivera: hi Etta, welcome aboard. Catan champion here (challenge accepted). also we have a few office plants that need weekend watering 94 want to adopt a small succulent for your desk?
Etta Morales: thanks Priya & Luca! i'll avoid nuts. very down for Catan 94 i live for sheep trades. would love a succulent if one is free.
Becky (People Ops): welcome @Etta Morales! onboarding buddy = @Priya Sengupta. i've added "cookies in kitchen" to the office calendar for Tue 10:30. noted: no peanuts. also FYI parking pass is in the welcome packet. quick poll: react :one: for chocolate chip, :two: for almond biscotti, :three: for both.
Luca Rivera: :three: (both please)
Priya Sengupta: :one: but i'll eat both if you bring extras :P
Luca Rivera: i'll swap a weekend plant-watering shift for a biscotti. fair trade?
Etta Morales: deal. i'll DM you to schedule watering. thanks for the warm welcome 94 i'll drop a calendar invite for the cookies and ping folks about Catan when i'm settled. :wave:
welcome-bot: Welcome @Etta Morales to #new-hires! Onboarding checklist assigned. Please complete security awareness training within 7 days. :sparkles:
Etta Morales: perfect, thanks all! can't wait to meet you in person :)
